projects.title: Modern Luxury Villa
projects.description: Full architectural design of a modern luxury villa including 3D visualization, interior detailing, and landscape integration.
projects.problem: The client needed a complete visual presentation of their villa concept before construction — floor plans alone weren't communicating the design vision.
projects.solution: Delivered a full 3D model with interior detailing, material selection, and landscape integration using 3ds Max and Lumion.
projects.result: Client approved the design on first presentation. The renders were used directly in the project proposal.

projects.title: Modern Front Elevation Concept
projects.description: Contemporary residential facade design emphasizing geometric balance, material contrast, and realistic 3D rendering.
projects.problem: The client needed to visualize multiple facade options quickly before committing to one direction.
projects.solution: Created a detailed 3D exterior model with material and lighting variations to support decision-making.
projects.result: Design was selected for development after client review of the rendered options.

projects.title: Contemporary Villa Elevation Concept
projects.description: Modern residential elevation concept showcasing material contrast, lighting realism, and refined facade detailing.
projects.problem: Needed to communicate a high-end residential aesthetic to a client unfamiliar with technical drawings.
projects.solution: Produced photorealistic renders with focus on material quality and natural lighting using 3ds Max and Lumion.
projects.result: Client could clearly evaluate and approve the design direction without needing to interpret technical plans.

projects.title: LevelUp
projects.description: A responsive e-commerce frontend for a gaming collectibles store, featuring dynamic product listings, filtering, and smooth UI interactions.
projects.problem: The store needed a modern frontend that felt fast and visually matched the gaming culture of its audience.
projects.solution: Built a fully responsive interface with React and Tailwind CSS, focusing on component reusability and smooth animations.
projects.result: Delivered a clean, performant UI with fast load times and intuitive browsing experience.

projects.title: Gaming Landing Page
projects.description: Interactive gaming landing page with responsive design, animated sections, and a bold visual identity built for a gaming brand.
projects.problem: The brand needed an engaging landing page that immediately communicated energy and identity to a gaming audience.
projects.solution: Designed and built an animated, fully responsive page using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap and vanilla JavaScript with attention to visual hierarchy.
projects.result: Delivered a high-impact page that works across all screen sizes with strong visual consistency.

projects.title: Lumo - Movies Platform
projects.description: A modern manga browsing platform with chapter navigation, series filtering, and optimized rendering for a smooth reading experience.
projects.problem: Users struggled with slow performance and unclear UI in existing manga platforms — content was hard to browse and pages loaded slowly.
projects.solution: Built a clean, responsive interface with optimized rendering using React and Vite, focusing on fast navigation and readable layout.
projects.result: Improved loading speed and provided a significantly smoother browsing and reading experience.

projects.title: Hu Tao Character Poster
projects.description: Character poster inspired by Genshin Impact featuring dynamic composition, cinematic lighting, and stylized color grading.
projects.problem: Wanted to create a fan art piece that matched the visual quality of official promotional material.
projects.solution: Used advanced Photoshop techniques — layer blending, light painting, and color grading — to achieve a cinematic result.
projects.result: Piece received strong community feedback and was shared across gaming design forums.

projects.title: Hu Tao Dark Edition
projects.description: Alternative dark-toned poster variation with dramatic shadows and enhanced character focus.
projects.problem: The original poster felt too bright for the character's darker personality traits in the game's lore.
projects.solution: Reworked the color grading and shadow balance to create a moodier, more character-accurate version.
projects.result: The dark edition was preferred by the community over the original for its tonal accuracy.

projects.title: Jean Character Poster
projects.description: Stylized promotional poster highlighting character presence through lighting manipulation and depth-focused composition.
projects.problem: Needed to convey authority and elegance matching the character's role as a high-ranking knight.
projects.solution: Applied directional lighting and depth-of-field composition to draw focus and communicate the character's presence.
projects.result: Clean, high-contrast poster that communicates character identity at a glance.

projects.title: Deku Motivational Design
projects.description: Typography-driven motivational artwork inspired by My Hero Academia with dramatic shadows and vibrant contrast.
projects.problem: Wanted to create a piece where the typography itself carried as much visual weight as the character art.
projects.solution: Designed a layout where bold type and character art work together structurally, not just decoratively.
projects.result: Strong visual hierarchy where the message and image reinforce each other.

projects.title: Healthy Lifestyle Campaign
projects.description: Marketing poster for a healthy food campaign focusing on clean visuals, fresh color palette, and a clear call to action.
projects.problem: The client needed advertising material that felt fresh and trustworthy, not clinical or generic.
projects.solution: Used a light, natural color palette with clean layout and minimal text to keep the focus on the product.
projects.result: Design was approved in the first round and used across the campaign's print and digital materials.

projects.title: Automotive Promotional Poster
projects.description: Car-themed promotional artwork featuring bold lighting effects and strong focal composition for advertising use.
projects.problem: The client needed a high-energy visual that made the vehicle the undisputed focal point.
projects.solution: Applied dramatic studio-style lighting and dark background to isolate and elevate the car as the hero element.
projects.result: Delivered a print-ready promotional asset that matched the brand's premium positioning.

projects.title: Banking Vector Illustration
projects.description: Minimal vector illustration for financial branding using clean lines and scalable design principles.
projects.problem: The financial brand needed a custom illustration that communicated trust and simplicity without using stock art.
projects.solution: Created a fully original flat vector illustration built for scalability across digital and print formats.
projects.result: Delivered a brand-aligned asset usable at any resolution without quality loss.

projects.title: Moon Night Landscape
projects.description: Flat-style nighttime landscape illustration focusing on depth layering and harmonious color blending.
projects.problem: Wanted to explore depth and atmosphere using only flat vector shapes — no gradients or blur effects.
projects.solution: Built depth through strategic layering and a limited, harmonious color palette across foreground, mid-ground, and sky.
projects.result: A calm, atmospheric piece that demonstrates control of composition and color theory within strict constraints.

projects.title: Anime Series Cover Art
projects.description: High-impact anime cover design with typography balance, bold color contrast, and modern layout composition.
projects.problem: Needed a cover that stood out visually while still feeling cohesive with the series' identity.
projects.solution: Combined strong typographic structure with a bold color contrast strategy to create immediate visual impact.
projects.result: Cover design effectively communicates series genre and tone at a glance.
